ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, extend the line segment $AB$ to $C$ so that $BC=4AB$. Let $D$ be the midpoint of line segment $BC$. If $CD=4\text{cm}$, and let $E$ be the midpoint of line segment $AC$, what is the length of $ED$ in cm?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that point $E$ is the midpoint of segment $AC$,\\
it follows that $AE=\frac{1}{2}AC=5\text{cm}$,\\
since $BD=4\text{cm}$ and $AB=2\text{cm}$,\\
we have $AD=AB+BD=6\text{cm}$,\\
therefore $ED=AD-AE=6-5=\boxed{1}\text{cm}$.
